company.name: Incandor
company.shortDescription: Incandor develops behavioral intelligence software and APIs for fraud detection on digital financial platforms.
company.description: Incandor develops behavioral intelligence infrastructure for fraud and abuse detection on digital financial platforms. The company builds a behavioral map of each user from physical interaction signals such as mouse movement, keystroke timing, scroll patterns, and mobile device orientation. Its software and APIs help banking and fintech platforms detect account takeovers, mule handoffs, shared operators, and coordinated fraud rings from the first session without relying on historical labels. Fraud and trust and safety teams integrate Incandor’s programmable API into their systems to combine behavioral signals with transaction data and business rules. The platform also supports use cases such as bot and agent detection and identifying sessions under stress or coercion before high‑risk actions occur.

productsAndServices.description: A behavioral intelligence API that maps user micro-behaviors to detect fraud, abuse, and account takeovers on financial platforms.
